_doc: WS3-D (#933) — LoRA training presets per base diffusion model. Edit values to tune defaults globally; users can override any field per training run via the UI.

sdxl.label: SDXL 1.0 (1024×1024)
sdxl.description: Stable Diffusion XL — best for portraits and characters at 1024px. Fits 12 GB VRAM with gradient checkpointing.

flux-dev.label: FLUX.1 dev (512×512)
flux-dev.description: FLUX.1 dev — highest quality face fidelity. 512×512 is the recommended resolution on 12 GB cards (Issue #939); push to 768 only with ≥24 GB pooled VRAM. 4-bit QLoRA + bf16 mixed precision.

flux-schnell.label: FLUX.1 schnell (768×768, 4-step)
flux-schnell.description: FLUX.1 schnell — distilled 4-step variant. Faster training but slightly lower fidelity than dev.

sd15.label: Stable Diffusion 1.5 (512×512)
sd15.description: SD 1.5 — fastest training, lowest VRAM. Use for quick character iterations or low-end GPUs.
